settings.content: Upload your custom font files via Settings → Files, then paste the file URLs below. Supported formats: woff2, woff, ttf, otf

settings.label: Enable custom fonts
settings.info: Turn on to use custom fonts in your theme

settings.label: Custom font family name
settings.info: Enter the name you want to use for this font (e.g., 'BrandFont', 'CustomSans')

settings.label: Regular font file URL
settings.info: Paste the URL of your regular weight font file (400 weight)

settings.label: Bold font file URL
settings.info: Optional — Paste the URL of your bold weight font file (700 weight)

settings.label: Italic font file URL
settings.info: Optional — Paste the URL of your italic font file

settings.label: Bold italic font file URL
settings.info: Optional — Paste the URL of your bold italic font file

settings.label: Apply to body text
settings.info: Replace the body font with your custom font

settings.label: Apply to headings
settings.info: Replace the heading font with your custom font

settings.label: Apply to subheadings
settings.info: Replace the subheading font with your custom font

settings.label: Apply to accent text
settings.info: Replace the accent font with your custom font
